label: VERIFIED
extraction: Orch Build MVP: orchestrates bootstrapping a working MVP from a design or spec document - ingest the doc, plan thin vertical slices, scaffold the first end-to-end slice, then TDD-implement, review, and gated commit. Use when a design or spec document must become a running MVP through planned vertical slices. Leverages orch-pipeline shared engine with Phase 3 Scaffold unique to this operation. Enables rapid MVP development through systematic vertical slice approach. Composes existing ECC commands: /feature-dev, /plan, /code-review, /build-fix, /refactor-clean, /gan-build, plus tdd-workflow skill. Adds shared size classifier and two gates on top.
